lcc_original: 那人說：『你所賜給我、和我同居的女人，她把那樹上的果子給了我，我就喫了。』
notes: LCC uses 和 where UNV uses 與 (both = עִם H5978); mapped straightforwardly
LCC inserts aspect particle 了 between 給 and 我, forming 給了我; SN tags split as 給<WH05414><WTH8804>了我<WAH09001> to preserve both the verb and dative annotations
LCC uses archaic 喫 in place of UNV's 吃 (both = אָכַל H398); SN placed after 喫了 following UNV convention of tagging after the verb+aspect unit
LCC uses 『』 quotation marks vs UNV's 「」; preserved LCC original punctuation as required
